title: JAH MC
description: This modpack offers a carefully selected mix of top-tier mods to create a versatile & engaging Minecraft experience. No shaders are included, so you have the freedom to customize your visuals any way you like. Dive in for plenty of adventures & activities!
body:
# **Overview**
This modpack provides a carefully curated selection of the best mods to deliver a versatile and engaging Minecraft experience. Designed for players who want a rich, enjoyable world without the need for shaders, it offers a customizable visual style—add your own shaders if you desire. Whether you're exploring, building, or adventuring, this pack has plenty of content to keep you entertained.

# **NO SHADERS INCLUDED**
The pack intentionally excludes shaders, giving you the freedom to enhance visuals with your preferred shader packs. This ensures optimal performance and compatibility across various systems, while still allowing you to customize the appearance to your liking.

# **Features & Gameplay**
Packed with a variety of mods, this modpack offers numerous activities and challenges. You can expect to find new biomes, tools, technology, magic, and adventure elements that cater to a wide range of play styles.

# **Mod Showcase**
## - **RPG Series:** 
  All RPG Series mods (Archers, Wizards, Paladins & Priests, Rogues & Warriors, Jewelry, Relics, & Arsenal) are all added. 

## - **The Aether:** 
  The Aether centers around a dimension high in the sky, filled with vast skylands of clouds and floating islands. This dimension features its own new survival adventure, based around a basic vanilla-esque survival progression that features new ores, mythical mobs, and three perilous dungeons each with their own powerful loot items.

## **- Yungs Better:**
  All Yungs Better mods (Better Nether Fortresses, Better Ocean Monuments, Better Dungeons, Better Mineshafts, Better Jungle Temples, Better End Island, Better Strongholds, Better Witches Huts, Bridges, Better Desert Temples, Extras, Cave Biomes & Better Caves). I have also included the Big Globe Mods for Yungs for Massive world generation.
